claims.subject: Solda-Lentini 2008 battery data
claims.object: a Ragone relation of premium Li-polymer batteries; data limited to discharge times of at least about 12.5 min
claims.statement: Solda and Lentini 2008 take battery power and energy densities from a Ragone plot of commercially available premium Li-polymer batteries (Fig. 1), as functions of discharge time; the interpolating line is limited to a minimum discharge time of about 12.5 min, which is the minimum burning time they consider. No single battery density is stated.
qualifiers: cell versus pack basis not stated
claims.quote: Notice that the line interpolating the data is limited to a minimum discharge time of about 12.5 min

claims.subject: Solda-Lentini 2008 electric pump sizing

claims.statement: Solda and Lentini 2008 size the conditioning/controller and electric pump unit together through a specific mass per unit electric power absorbed (6 kg/kW_e) with overall efficiency 0.68; they give no separate motor or inverter density or efficiency.
